story: Use saved visual captions plus timestamped speech to recall the event. Keep original captions and full transcripts separately; uncertain or repetitive ASR is withheld. The backfill never sends images to a model.
decision: Mac Metal handles most speech recognition and still-fawn CPU adds spare capacity. RTX was benchmarked with an accounted share and returned to Immich search. Clear English uses a text-only local story path; difficult translation has a user-authorized Codex adapter with idempotent submissions and a separate $10 API-equivalent estimate cap. Original media stays local.
method: Six fixed private clips capped at their first 30 seconds plus a 10-second silence control: 151.93 source seconds. Whisper small Q5_1 multilingual, Silero VAD, two CPU threads, warm model servers (first-request warmup may remain), beam 1. One cell per clip/backend under live host contention; extraction excluded, HTTP transfer included. Beam 3 uses a matched 70-second subset only; compare its overlapping cells separately. No reference word-error-rate or full-video accuracy score.
quality: Three paired prompt checks against saved captions and automatic speech exposed misleading Tamil-to-English interpretations. Non-English and mixed-script spoken context now waits for a capable Codex translator, enabled after explicit destination authorization and four final text-level pilot checks. Low-confidence/repetitive ASR is withheld automatically. No human-labelled audio reference or accuracy score.

translation_status.authorization: Selected speech transcripts and short saved visual descriptions to OpenAI via existing Codex login; original media stays local

translation_review.observations: Revised prompt retained clear English commentary and translated a clean Tamil hiking sentence; both garbled Tamil transcripts were withheld. First prompt was overcautious. Checks compare text meaning, not a human-labelled audio reference.
